name: apex-fan-mongodb
description: World Cup 2026 Smart Concierge & Fan Coordinator utilizing MongoDB MCP + Google Agent Builder

scripts.deploy:api: gcloud run deploy apex-fan-mongodb --project apexfan-mongodb-2026 --source . --region us-central1 --no-invoker-iam-check --min-instances 0 --max-instances 1 --cpu 1 --memory 512Mi --set-secrets MONGODB_URI=MONGODB_URI:latest
scripts.deploy:api:with-gemini: gcloud run deploy apex-fan-mongodb --project apexfan-mongodb-2026 --source . --region us-central1 --no-invoker-iam-check --min-instances 0 --max-instances 1 --cpu 1 --memory 512Mi --set-secrets MONGODB_URI=MONGODB_URI:latest,GEMINI_API_KEY=GEMINI_API_KEY:latest
scripts.deploy:api:with-vertex: gcloud run deploy apex-fan-mongodb --project apexfan-mongodb-2026 --source . --region us-central1 --no-invoker-iam-check --min-instances 0 --max-instances 1 --cpu 1 --memory 512Mi --set-env-vars USE_VERTEX_AI=true,GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=apexfan-mongodb-2026,GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION=us-west1 --set-secrets MONGODB_URI=MONGODB_URI:latest
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api:with-vertex && npm run deploy:hosting
